title: Patrick at Micro Center Columbus Ohio Grand Reopening with Jeff Geerling

insights.claim: Micro Center's Columbus, Ohio store has been rebuilt as a newly updated flagship location that incorporates design principles from the chain's newer stores.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Specialty PC-component retail is still investing in large physical flagship formats rather than retreating to e-commerce.
insights.quote: The newly updated flagship store is huge, and incorporates many of the design principles from its newer stores.
insights.locator: Patrick at Micro Center Columbus, Ohio

insights.claim: On opening day a line had already formed around the back of the building for the store's grand reopening, and hardware YouTubers including Jayztwocents were on site running live streams.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Enthusiast hardware demand still converts into physical foot traffic, which supports the store-opening economics of PC component retailers.
insights.quote: If you are in the area, there is already a line around the back of the building, but it seems like this is going to be a big event.
insights.locator: If you are in the area, there

insights.claim: A hardware retailer is using creator-led live streams with independent tech reviewers as the centerpiece of a store-opening marketing event rather than conventional advertising.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Marketing spend in the enthusiast hardware channel is shifting toward independent creators, which matters for how component vendors reach buyers.
insights.locator: If you are in the Columbus, Ohio area

insights.claim: The Minisforum N5 Max is being presented as an all-in-one homelab machine and is the subject of a retailer-hosted livestream.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Consolidated single-box homelab systems are getting retail-channel promotion, signaling a productizable niche between consumer NAS and rack servers.
insights.quote: The other big project, and the subject of Micro Center’s livestream I will be participating in, is the Minisforum N5 Max as an all-in-one homelab.
insights.locator: The other big project, and the subject

insights.claim: A demonstration mini-rack build is being assembled around the Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Gateway Fiber (UCG-Fiber), a product previously reviewed the prior year.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Ubiquiti's fiber gateway is becoming a default anchor component in enthusiast mini-rack builds, an indicator of mindshare in prosumer networking.
insights.quote: Jeff and I are going to work on a mini-rack that will incorporate the Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Gateway Fiber UCG-Fiber that we reviewed last year.
insights.locator: Jeff and I are going to work

gist: ServeTheHome's Patrick Kennedy previews his appearance at Micro Center's grand reopening of its rebuilt Columbus, Ohio flagship store, where he will join Jeff Geerling on a mini-rack build using the Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Gateway Fiber and appear on a Micro Center livestream about the Minisforum N5 Max as an all-in-one homelab. The post notes a line already forming around the building and other hardware creators such as Jayztwocents streaming on site.
